investment_thesis.summary: ResMed combines direct aging-in-place exposure with recurring masks and accessories, connected home-care technology, strong margins, cash generation and a net-cash balance sheet.
market_implied_assumptions: Organic growth moderates toward mid-single digits
Recent gross-margin expansion is not fully durable
Alternative therapies reduce some future treatment starts
Portfolio simplification produces limited incremental value
why_price_may_differ_from_value: Fiscal 2026 results had not been released at the review timestamp
Uncertainty regarding obesity therapies and alternative sleep-apnea treatments
Potential normalization of recent margin gains

conditions: Margins remain structurally above prior-cycle levels

bull.method: Forward normalized earnings with cash-flow cross-check
assumptions: Normalized EPS reference of approximately 13.65 dollars
Normalized EPS reference of approximately 12.50 dollars
Normalized EPS reference of approximately 10 dollars

valuation.explanation: The valuation uses scenario-specific normalized earnings and multiples. Net cash is a supporting balance-sheet factor and is not added separately to avoid double counting value already reflected in the earnings multiple.

catalysts.name: Fiscal 2026 results
catalysts.expected_effect: Update revenue, margin, earnings and cash-flow assumptions

catalysts.name: MatrixCare portfolio simplification
catalysts.expected_effect: Potentially improve focus, margins and capital allocation

catalysts.name: New mask and device launches
catalysts.expected_effect: Support market share and recurring resupply

invalidation_conditions: Gross margin below 58% without a temporary explanation
Material decline in mask and accessory demand
Evidence that alternative therapies structurally reduce the addressable market

decision.summary: ResMed offers the strongest combination of business quality and valuation support among the selected aging companies, but the current price is just above the attractive threshold and fiscal 2026 results are pending.
required_actions: Update fiscal 2026 earnings and cash-flow inputs
Recalculate entry zones after management guidance
